name: Haritha Hotel Ramappa (TSTDC Resort)
price: ₹2,000-₹4,000 per night, depending on room type and season
description: Located near Ramappa Lake in Palampet, Mulugu District. Offers accommodation, restaurant facilities, parking and scenic lake surroundings.

name: Haritha Lake View Resort, Ramappa
price: ₹2,000-₹4,500 per night, depending on room type and availability
description: Located near Ramappa Lake and close to Ramappa Temple. Features accommodation, restaurant facilities, parking and a lake-view setting. Advance booking is recommended, especially during weekends and holidays.

name: Haritha Grand, Mulugu
price: Price varies by room type and booking date
description: Located on Warangal–Mulugu Road near Gattamma Village. Suitable for pilgrims looking for accommodation closer to Mulugu town.

name: Haritha Hotel Laknavaram
price: Price varies by cottage or room type and booking date
description: A tourism resort near Laknavaram Lake, known for its scenic surroundings and cottages. Suitable if you want to combine a Ramappa Temple visit with Laknavaram tourism.

name: G.M.R Residency
price: Price varies by room type and booking date
description: An accommodation option farther from Ramappa Temple, with AC and non-AC rooms and parking mentioned in traveller listings.
